bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and oversized bags are prohibited; the venue does not specify a numeric size limit for smaller bags. All admitted bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking decks directly behind the theater and metered street spaces within walking distance are available.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue information and FAQ do not designate an app-based rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Five full bars on the first and second floors sell drinks, and pizza is available by the slice at the bars. Outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance is accessible and ADA viewing is on the main-floor house-left riser. Accessible stalls are on the first floor and in both VIP bathrooms; request an interpreter at least two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The National FAQ describes the connected outdoor smoking patio but does not publish a general rule for leaving and re-entering the building.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office sells tickets Thursday and Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and from one hour before doors on show nights; AXS Mobile ID tickets are scanned from the AXS app.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open one hour before showtime, but consult the event listing or ticket for the actual time. All bags are searched.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
